about_you.label: About you
about_you.description: Your role, and what you want done.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.description: Name it and pick its URL.

runtime.label: Meet Patrick

welcome.headline: A multi-agent system built for long-horizon tasks
welcome.lede: Automatically split, orchestrate, and run work until the goal is done.
welcome.lede_web: Use your own subscription through ACP.
welcome.lede_desktop: By the end, a real agent will be replying to your first issue.

source_backfill.lede: One quick question — it helps us understand who finds Patchbay useful. Answer once and you're back to your work.
source_backfill.hint_ready: Looks good. Hit Submit when you're ready.

about_you.question: Tell us a bit about you.

source.question: How did you hear about Patchbay?
source.other_placeholder: e.g. a podcast I listen to

use_case.question: What do you want to use Patchbay for?

step_question.hint_pick: Pick one to continue — or skip if you'd rather not say.
step_question.hint_continue: Looks good. Hit Continue when you're ready.

cli_install.intro: You'll need Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar on this computer for it to show up as a device and run your agent. Also works on servers and remote dev boxes.

cloud_waitlist.intro_main: Cloud devices aren't live yet. Leave your email and we'll reach out when they are.
cloud_waitlist.intro_warning: Heads-up: agents can't execute tasks without a device — if you hit Skip now, nothing will run until you come back and install one.
cloud_waitlist.reason_placeholder: e.g. we want agents running 24/7, or my team works across different devices.
cloud_waitlist.success_toast: You're on the list. We'll email when cloud devices are live.

skip.title: Welcome to Patchbay!
skip.subtitle: We've added one issue to help you connect a device. When it's ready, start with Patrick from Devices.
skip.error_body: The device guide didn't get created. You can try again, or connect a device from the Devices page whenever you're ready.

install_runtime.title: Connect a device
install_runtime.subtitle: Install Codex or Kimi, then start the guided Patrick chat from Devices.

step_workspace.lede_first: A workspace is where your issues, agents, and projects live. You can invite teammates or spin up more workspaces later.
step_workspace.lede_resume: Resume setup with the workspace you already have, or create a new one alongside it — you can belong to any number of workspaces.
step_workspace.name_placeholder: Acme Inc, My Lab, Side Projects…
step_workspace.issue_prefix_suffix: . You can change this later in settings.
step_workspace.issue_prefix_pending: Set the URL above and issue numbers will follow it — or type a prefix here.
step_workspace.create_new_subtitle: Start fresh — a separate space for a different side of your work.
step_workspace.hint_name_first: Name your workspace to create it.
step_workspace.hint_pick: Pick your workspace or start a new one.
step_workspace.slug_format_error: Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
step_workspace.slug_taken_error: That workspace URL is already taken.
step_workspace.slug_reserved_error: That workspace URL is reserved and cannot be used.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_headline: Ask your administrator for an invitation.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_lede: This Patchbay instance does not allow new workspaces to be created. Once an administrator invites you to a workspace, accept the invitation and refresh to continue.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_lede_resume: Workspace creation is disabled on this instance, so you'll continue into your existing workspace.
step_workspace.projects_hint: Attach more than one. You can add more later.
step_workspace.projects_invalid_url: Enter a valid git repository URL
step_workspace.projects_attach_failed: Workspace created, but some projects could not be attached

step_runtime.scanning_lede_prefix: Your agent works through an AI coding tool you already have — like
step_runtime.scanning_lede_suffix: , and others. We're checking this computer for ones you've installed.
step_runtime.found_lede: These are the devices we found on this computer. You can switch it or add more later.
step_runtime.empty_headline: No device found on this computer yet.
step_runtime.empty_lede_prefix: A device is an AI coding tool we connect to — like
step_runtime.empty_lede_suffix: . Install one and refresh, or pick a path below.
step_runtime.empty_skip_subtitle: Enter your workspace now. Your agent can't run tasks until a device is connected on this computer — but you can still browse, plan, and invite teammates.
step_runtime.empty_waitlist_subtitle: We'll run a computer for you in the cloud. Not live yet.
step_runtime.hint_pick: Pick a device above to start with Patrick.
step_runtime.hint_skip_or_refresh: Refresh after installing one, or skip to enter your workspace.

step_platform.headline: Connect a computer to run your agent.
step_platform.lede: Patrick, your workspace's Chief of Staff, runs on a real computer that you connect to Patchbay. Pick how you want to connect one.
step_platform.hint_default: Pick a way to connect — or skip and connect a computer later.
step_platform.download_subtitle: Install our desktop app to connect this computer. Opens in a new tab — pick your platform there.
step_platform.cli_subtitle: Connect a server, remote dev box, or any headless computer. Terminal required.
step_platform.cloud_subtitle: We'll run a computer for you in the cloud. Not live yet.
step_platform.cli_dialog_description: Same connection as Desktop, set up from the terminal. Use it for servers, remote dev boxes, or any headless computer.
step_platform.stage_normal_prefix: Run the command above. As soon as
step_platform.stage_normal_suffix: finishes browser sign-in, your computer will appear here automatically (usually 10–30 seconds).
step_platform.stage_midway_prefix: Still listening. Make sure you finished the browser tab that
step_platform.stage_midway_suffix: opened — it needs you to approve sign-in before your computer can connect.
step_platform.stage_slow_prefix: Taking longer than usual. Check the terminal where you ran
step_platform.stage_stalled_prefix: Nothing coming through yet. If you're not comfortable with the terminal,
step_platform.stage_stalled_suffix: is the smoother path — one click and this computer is connected. Close this dialog and pick Desktop, or hit Skip to continue.

patrick_intro.headline: Meet Patrick, your first agent teammate.
patrick_intro.name: Patrick
patrick_intro.blurb: Tell Patrick what you want done. It becomes an issue, with the right agent on it.
